mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, compressing equity discount rates and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to declining corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate sales visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening with high inflation (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 6%) triggers market repricing of higher discount rates and recession risks, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 6% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below its 3-month moving average signals supply chain disruption and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced corporate output expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 3-month MA over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls exceeding 150,000 thousand indicate robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000 thousand over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) reflects weakening economic activity and consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue outlooks.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive Fed tightening and higher real interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual change > 5% over any 3-year rolling window.
